name: hold-to-confirm
title: Hold to Confirm
description: Press-and-hold destructive action — a ring traces the border, release early to cancel.
instruction: A destructive-action button requiring press-and-hold: while held, an error-red ring traces the button border via SVG stroke offset; releasing early drains the ring back at 2.5x speed; when the ring closes the action confirms, the label swaps and the button gives a small spring pulse. Works with pointer and keyboard (hold Space/Enter). No accidental destructive clicks.
